description: This file is a PHPUnit test class named HelpServiceTest that tests the HelpService class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It contains test methods for various functionalities such as retrieving configurations, processors, and URLs, using mock objects and HTTP response simulations.

classes.name: HelpServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HelpService component of the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It verifies proper functionality and URL responses for the help service.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a HelpService instance, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService() returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetZendeskHelpProcessor
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpProcessor() returns an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Mocks a ZendeskHelpProcessor to simulate fetching an article URL and verifies getRedirectUrl returns the correct URL for a specific article.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Mocks a ZendeskHelpProcessor to simulate no articles found and verifies getRedirectUrl returns the default help URL.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Ensures getDefaultRedirectUrl() returns the expected base help URL.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl
methods.description: Checks whether the help URL configured in the system is valid.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl2
methods.description: Simulates an invalid base help URL and verifies that isValidUrl() correctly returns false.
